Primary Question: What are my active projects?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show the projects I am currently working on.
Alternative Phrasing 2: List my ongoing projects.

SELECT DISTINCT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_unique_id,
    p.project_key,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    ps.status_name,
    st.stage_name,
    p.priority,
    p.rag
FROM tbl_projects p
JOIN tbl_project_users pu
    ON p.project_id = pu.project_id
JOIN tbl_users u
    ON u.user_id = pu.user_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_project_status ps
    ON ps.status_id = p.project_status_id

WHERE u.email = :current_user  AND pu.request_status = 'A'
  AND pu.status = 1
  AND p.status = 1
  AND p.archive = 0

Primary Question: Which projects are overdue?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show active projects past their end date.
Alternative Phrasing 2: List delayed projects.
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.project_unique_id,
    p.project_key,
    p.title AS project_name,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    ps.status_name,
    p.priority,
    p.rag,
    DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), p.end_date) AS overdue_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.task_id) AS total_tasks,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN t.due_date < CURDATE()
                 AND t.percent_complete < 100
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS overdue_tasks
FROM tbl_projects p
LEFT JOIN tbl_project_status ps
    ON ps.status_id = p.project_status_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_project_tasks t
    ON t.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE
    p.status = 1
    AND p.archive = 0
    AND p.end_date < CURDATE()
GROUP BY
    p.project_id,
    p.project_unique_id,
    p.project_key,
    p.title,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    ps.status_name,
    p.priority,
    p.rag
ORDER BY
    overdue_days DESC,
    overdue_tasks DESC;

Primary Question: Show risk creation and closure trend for the last :months months.

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(months.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COALESCE(created.risks_created, 0) AS risks_created,
    COALESCE(closed.risks_closed, 0) AS risks_closed
FROM
(
    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_raised, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start
    FROM tbl_risk
    WHERE date_raised >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)

    UNION

    SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date_closed, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start
    FROM tbl_risk
    WHERE date_closed >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
) months

        COUNT(*) AS risks_created
    FROM tbl_risk
    WHERE date_raised >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date_raised, '%Y-%m-01')
) created
ON months.month_start = created.month_start

LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT
        DATE_FORMAT(date_closed, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start,
        COUNT(*) AS risks_closed
    FROM tbl_risk
    WHERE date_closed >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH)

) closed
ON months.month_start = closed.month_start

Primary Question: Generate a live weekly task summary for :project_name.
Alternative Phrasing 1: Summarise task activity for :project_name between :week_start and :week_end.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Show this week’s task KPIs for :project_name.
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,
    task_stats.total_tasks,
    task_stats.open_tasks,          -- status_type IN (1,2,4,6) -- confirm UAT/Reopened treatment with developer
    task_stats.completed_tasks,     -- status_type = 3
    task_stats.high_priority_tasks,
    task_stats.avg_completion,
    task_stats.last_task_update,
    COALESCE(ts_stats.logged_hours, 0) AS logged_hours
FROM tbl_projects p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        t.project_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.task_id) AS total_tasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.status_type IN (1,2,4,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_tasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.status_type = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.priority = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_tasks,
        ROUND(AVG(t.percent_complete), 2) AS avg_completion,
        MAX(t.update_date) AS last_task_update
    FROM tbl_project_tasks t
    LEFT JOIN tbl_project_task_status s ON s.task_status_id = t.task_status_id
    WHERE t.update_date BETWEEN :week_start AND :week_end
       OR t.due_date BETWEEN :week_start AND :week_end
    GROUP BY t.project_id
) task_stats ON task_stats.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT t.project_id,
           ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)), 2) AS logged_hours
    FROM tbl_project_tasks t
    INNER JOIN tbl_timesheets ts ON ts.task_id = t.task_id
    WHERE ts.timesheet_date BETWEEN :week_start AND :week_end
    GROUP BY t.project_id
) ts_stats ON ts_stats.project_id = p.project_id
WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.archive = 0 AND p.title = :project_name;

    ROUND(AVG(t.percent_complete),2) AS completion_percentage,

    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)),2) AS total_timesheet_hours,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((p.total_hours_booked / NULLIF(p.estimate,0))*100,2) >= 80

FROM tbl_projects p

LEFT JOIN tbl_project_tasks t

LEFT JOIN tbl_timesheets ts

WHERE p.status = 1
  AND p.archive = 0
  AND p.start_date <= '2026-08-11'

GROUP BY
    p.project_id,
    p.title,
    p.estimate,
    p.total_hours_booked

LEFT JOIN tbl_project_issue_status s ON s.issue_status_id = i.issue_status_id
WHERE
    p.status = 1
    AND p.archive = 0
    AND (
        i.date_raised BETWEEN :range_start AND :as_of_date
        OR i.date_closed BETWEEN :range_start AND :as_of_date
    )
GROUP BY p.project_id, p.title
HAVING COUNT(i.issue_id) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_open_issue_age DESC, avg_closure_days DESC;

Primary Question: Which projects have the highest defect leakage from earlier origination phases into later detection phases?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show defect leakage by project and phase.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Where are defects being found later than they should be?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT

    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,

    i.defect_origination_phase,
    i.defect_detection_phase,

    COUNT(i.issue_id) AS total_defects,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN i.defect_detection_phase > i.defect_origination_phase
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS leaked_defects,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN i.defect_detection_phase > i.defect_origination_phase
                    THEN 1
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF(COUNT(i.issue_id),0)
        )*100,
        2
    ) AS leakage_rate,

    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN i.severity >= 3
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS high_severity_defects

FROM tbl_project_issues i

INNER JOIN tbl_projects p
ON i.project_id = p.project_id

WHERE

p.status = 1
AND p.archive = 0

AND i.date_raised BETWEEN '2026-01-01'
AND '2026-08-11'

GROUP BY

p.project_id,
p.title,
i.defect_origination_phase,
i.defect_detection_phase

HAVING

COUNT(i.issue_id) >= 5

ORDER BY

leakage_rate DESC,
high_severity_defects DESC;

Primary Question: Which overdue or closed high-severity issues are missing RCA, correction, or corrective-action details?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show issue governance records that are incomplete.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Which major defects lack documented root-cause and prevention actions?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,
    CONCAT(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS project_manager,
    c.client_name,
    i.issue_id,
    i.reference_no,
    i.title AS issue_title,
    i.severity,
    i.date_raised,
    i.date_closed,
    i.planned_closure_date,
    CASE
        WHEN s.status_type != 3 AND i.planned_closure_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00' AND i.planned_closure_date < :as_of_date THEN 'Overdue'
        WHEN s.status_type = 3 THEN 'Closed'
        ELSE 'Open'
    END AS issue_status,
    i.rca,
    i.correction,
    i.corrective_action
FROM tbl_project_issues i
INNER JOIN tbl_projects p ON i.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON p.pm_user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_clients c ON p.client_id = c.client_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_project_issue_status s ON s.issue_status_id = i.issue_status_id
WHERE
    p.status = 1
    AND p.archive = 0
    AND i.severity >= 3
    AND (
        (s.status_type != 3 AND i.planned_closure_date <> '0000-00-00 00:00:00' AND i.planned_closure_date < :as_of_date)
        OR s.status_type = 3
    )
    AND (
        i.rca IS NULL OR i.rca = 0
        OR i.correction IS NULL OR TRIM(i.correction) = ''
        OR i.corrective_action IS NULL OR TRIM(i.corrective_action) = ''
    )
ORDER BY i.severity DESC, i.planned_closure_date, p.title;

Primary Question: Which risks remain high after mitigation, and which risks have not improved?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Compare original and residual risk scores.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Where has mitigation failed to reduce exposure?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,

    r.risk_id,
    r.reference_no,
    r.title AS risk_title,

    r.rating AS original_risk_score,
    r.after_mitigation_risk_score AS residual_risk_score,

    r.probability_id,
    r.impact_id,

    r.revised_probability,
    r.revised_impact,

    r.owner_id,

    CASE

        WHEN r.after_mitigation_risk_score >= 15
        THEN 'High Residual Risk'

        WHEN r.after_mitigation_risk_score >= r.rating
        THEN 'No Improvement'

        WHEN r.after_mitigation_risk_score < r.rating
        THEN 'Improved'

        ELSE 'Unknown'

    END AS mitigation_status

FROM tbl_risk r

INNER JOIN tbl_projects p
ON r.project_id=p.project_id

WHERE

p.status=1
AND p.archive=0

AND r.status=1

AND
(
        r.after_mitigation_risk_score>=15

        OR

        r.after_mitigation_risk_score>=r.rating
)

ORDER BY

r.after_mitigation_risk_score DESC,
r.rating DESC;

Primary Question: Which risk owners carry the largest concentration of high-exposure or overdue risks?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Rank risk owners by unresolved exposure.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Who needs support or escalation for risk closure?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    u.user_id,
    CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS risk_owner,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.status_type != 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_risks,          -- was COUNT(r.risk_id): counted closed risks too
    SUM(r.rating) AS total_risk_exposure,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.target_closure_date < :as_of_date AND s.status_type != 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_risks,  -- was r.date_closed IS NULL, always-false due to zero-date default
    ROUND(AVG(DATEDIFF(:as_of_date, r.date_raised)), 2) AS avg_open_age,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.project_id) AS affected_projects,
    SUM(p.deal_value) AS total_deal_value
FROM tbl_risk r
INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON r.owner_id = u.user_id
INNER JOIN tbl_projects p ON r.project_id = p.project_id
LEFT JOIN tbl_risk_status s ON s.status_id = r.status_id
WHERE
    r.status = 1
    AND p.status = 1
    AND p.archive = 0
GROUP BY u.user_id, risk_owner
ORDER BY total_risk_exposure DESC, overdue_risks DESC, avg_open_age DESC
LIMIT 10;

Alternative Phrasing 1: Show incomplete risk treatment records.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Which major risks are not actionable because key fields are missing?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT

    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,

    r.risk_id,
    r.reference_no,
    r.title AS risk_title,

    r.owner_id,
    CONCAT(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS risk_owner,

    r.rating,
    r.after_mitigation_risk_score,

    r.mitigation_action_plan,
    r.contingency_action_plan,
    r.responsibility,
    r.target_closure_date,

    CASE

        WHEN r.mitigation_action_plan IS NULL
             OR TRIM(r.mitigation_action_plan)=''

        WHEN r.contingency_action_plan IS NULL
             OR TRIM(r.contingency_action_plan)=''

        THEN 'Missing Responsibility'

        WHEN r.target_closure_date IS NULL

FROM tbl_risk r

INNER JOIN tbl_projects p
ON r.project_id=p.project_id

LEFT JOIN tbl_users u
ON r.owner_id=u.user_id

WHERE

AND p.status=1

AND

p.deal_value DESC,

SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
-- Written 2026-08-27: no stored weekly-capacity field exists (O-09/O-10) -- caller supplies the threshold. Reports CURRENT allocation (allocation_from/allocation_to not populated).
SELECT u.user_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS employee_name,

INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON pu.user_id = u.user_id

Primary Question: Which resources have the largest mismatch between allocated hours and actual logged effort?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Compare allocation against timesheet consumption.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Who is materially over- or under-consuming their allocation?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
-- Written 2026-08-27: allocation side is CURRENT total (allocation_from/allocation_to not populated); timesheet side is genuinely period-scoped via timesheet_date.
SELECT u.user_id, CONCAT(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) AS employee_name,
    SUM(pu.allocation_hrs) AS total_allocated_hours,
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)), 2) AS total_logged_hours,
    ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)) - SUM(pu.allocation_hrs), 2) AS variance_hours
FROM tbl_users u
LEFT JOIN tbl_project_users pu ON pu.user_id = u.user_id AND pu.status = 1 AND pu.request_status = 'A'
LEFT JOIN tbl_timesheets ts ON ts.user_id = u.user_id AND ts.timesheet_date BETWEEN :period_start AND :period_end
WHERE u.enabled = 1 AND u.verified = 1 AND u.is_block = 0
GROUP BY u.user_id, employee_name
HAVING ABS(ROUND(SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)) - SUM(pu.allocation_hrs), 2)) >= :variance_threshold
ORDER BY ABS(variance_hours) DESC;

Primary Question: Which resource allocations end before their assigned open tasks or project delivery dates?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show allocation end-date risks.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Where could resources roll off before remaining work is due?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
-- Resolved 2026-08-27: allocation_to is not populated -- comparing it to task/project dates is not possible from this data.
SELECT u.user_id, CONCAT(u.first_name,' ',u.last_name) AS employee_name,
    p.project_id, p.title AS project_name,
    pu.allocation_from, pu.allocation_to,
    pt.task_id, pt.title AS task_name, pt.priority, pt.rag, pt.due_date, p.end_date,
    DATEDIFF(pt.due_date, pu.allocation_to) AS task_gap_days,
    DATEDIFF(p.end_date, pu.allocation_to) AS project_gap_days
FROM tbl_project_users pu
INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON pu.user_id = u.user_id
INNER JOIN tbl_projects p ON pu.project_id = p.project_id
INNER JOIN tbl_project_task_users ptu ON pu.user_id = ptu.user_id
INNER JOIN tbl_project_tasks pt ON ptu.task_id = pt.task_id AND pt.project_id = pu.project_id
WHERE pu.status = 1 AND pu.request_status = 'A'
  AND p.status = 1 AND p.archive = 0
  AND pu.allocation_to IS NOT NULL
  AND pu.allocation_to <= DATE_ADD('2026-08-11', INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  AND (pt.due_date > pu.allocation_to OR p.end_date > pu.allocation_to)
ORDER BY pu.allocation_to, pt.due_date;

Primary Question: What percentage of logged effort is chargeable by project, PM, client, and project type?
Alternative Phrasing 1: Show chargeable versus non-chargeable effort mix.
Alternative Phrasing 2: Where is non-chargeable delivery effort concentrated?
SQL Query (Existing or Recovered):
SELECT
    p.project_id,
    p.title AS project_name,

    ROUND(SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN t.chargeable = 'Y'
            THEN IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ),2) AS chargeable_hours,

    ROUND(SUM(
        IFNULL(ts.hours,0) + (IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)
    ),2) AS total_hours,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.chargeable='Y'
                    THEN IFNULL(ts.hours,0)+(IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            /
            NULLIF(
                SUM(IFNULL(ts.hours,0)+(IFNULL(ts.minutes,0)/60)),
                0
            )
        )*100,
        2
    ) AS chargeable_effort_ratio

FROM tbl_timesheets ts

INNER JOIN tbl_project_tasks t
    ON ts.task_id=t.task_id

INNER JOIN tbl_projects p
    ON t.project_id=p.project_id

WHERE
    p.status=1
    AND p.archive=0

GROUP BY
    p.project_id,
    p.title

ORDER BY
    chargeable_effort_ratio DESC;
